sources.name: IRS: Estate tax
sources.says: A return is required when the gross estate, plus adjusted taxable gifts and specific exemption, is more than the filing threshold for the year of death; the table gives 2026: $15,000,000. Page last reviewed or updated 23-Oct-2026.

sources.says: "Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000", up from $13,990,000 for 2025; the release (October 9, 2025) cites Revenue Procedure 2025-32 and is marked as an archival document.

sources.name: IRS: Some nonresidents with U.S. assets must file estate tax returns
sources.says: "U.S. citizens are subject to U.S. estate taxation with respect to their worldwide assets"; Form 706 is required when worldwide assets plus adjusted taxable gifts exceed the basic exclusion amount in effect on the date of death. "a community hospital in San Ignacio"; "La Loma Luz Hospital on the Western Highway at Santa Elena is the main private choice for the Cayo expat belt" (Seventh-day Adventist); "Western Regional serves Belmopan"; Karl Heusner Memorial Hospital "is the national referral hospital"; regional destinations Mérida, Cancún, San Pedro Sula and Guatemala City, and "Miami remains the option". "Ambergris Caye has San Pedro Polyclinic and San Juan Health Center"; "The two most popular foreign destinations have no hospital." Placencia has "a single health centre"; "The nearest hospital to Placencia is Southern Regional in Dangriga". "Corozal has its own community hospital and the Mexican town of Chetumal across the border"; the private Northern Medical Specialty Plaza is in Orange Walk.

sources.name: GOV.UK: Belize list of medical facilities
sources.says: Last updated 1 June 2021. San Ignacio Hospital (gynaecology, surgery, paediatrics, internal medicine); La Loma Luz Adventist Hospital, Santa Elena; Western Regional Hospital, Belmopan; Karl Heusner Memorial Hospital, Belize City (public; ICU, A&E); San Pedro Polyclinic II, San Pedro Town ("24-hour general healthcare", radiology, lab); Southern Regional Hospital, Dangriga (public; general and maternity care, ICU, pre/post-surgical care); Corozal Community Hospital (public; internal medicine, general surgery, paediatrics, OB/GYN, orthopaedics); Northern Medical Specialty Plaza, Orange Walk (private). No entry for Placencia or Hopkins.

sources.name: Rome2rio: Placencia to Dangriga
sources.says: Bus "Ave. Duration 1h 21m"; shuttle about 1h 15m. No driving time or road distance given. Undated.

claims.note: The page supports the low end (about 1¼ hours); the 1¾ upper bound is a slower trip, inside the "about" range.

claims.claim: Private care is in Belize City, 3½ hours by road

sources.name: Moon: Getting to and around Placencia
sources.says: "It's now about a three- or four-hour drive from Belize City." "At last check, there were more than 20 daily flights in and out of Placencia's airstrip." No date beyond road paving completed in 2010.

claims.claim: Tropic Air's 24-hour medical transfers do not list Placencia

sources.name: Tropic Air: Medical transfer
sources.says: Service "24 hours a day, year round" from San Pedro and Caye Caulker to Belize City tertiary care facilities; "All passengers aboard a medical transfer flight must be medically stable"; regional transfers to Mérida, Cancún, San Pedro Sula and Guatemala City. Placencia appears only in the airline's general "Where We Fly" list, not as a medical-transfer origin. Undated.

claims.note: The medical-transfer text names only San Pedro and Caye Caulker as origins; Placencia appears in the general route list only.

claims.claim: Only a small public clinic in the village
claims.oldWording: Only a small public clinic in the village;
claims.newWording: Only a community health post in the village, whose nurse is not on site full time;

sources.name: Global Brigades: Hopkins Village
sources.says: Work there began in 2025 (medical brigade June 2025). Hopkins "has a community health post; however, the nurse attending the community members is not permanently on-site"; "there are no other private clinics"; no lab.

claims.note: "A small public clinic" overstated it: the page describes a health post without a permanent nurse.

claims.claim: The public Southern Regional Hospital in Dangriga (general, maternity, intensive and surgical care) is about 20 miles, or 30 minutes, by road
